plugins.name: null-to-hero
plugins.description: From zero knowledge to hero website. Ten doors on four skills and 68 commands: design and build (siteasy), SEO and GEO for AI search, handing a finished site to its owner (cms), and a whole-site /audit orchestrator that also owns the deterministic scan and the code review running 15 parallel sub-agents with a deterministic pre-pass. Say the goal (express, build, improve, fix, ship, overhaul); the right specialist runs. Legacy names stay accepted via a versioned alias table.
